messages:
joanne: opened a small PR to consolidate model-card quicknotes into the catalog page + add a short TS SDK snippet for quant fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
mark: looks good. can we explicitly call out the embedding-dimension change risk when switching variants? we saw one customer break nearest-neighbor thresholds after a quant rollout.
joanne: added a one-line migration checklist: verify dims, re-index embeddings, and adjust thresholds. also a short example of client-side shard reassembly.
samir: please include a tiny TypeScript snippet showing model_variant usage and an example of passing context_window. many frontend teams copy TS directly.
joanne: added TS snippet:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'zephyr-mini-4b', model_variant: 'q4_0', input: 'hi', context_window: 8192 });
console.log(res.text);
```
mark: small nit: context_window is advisory; mention truncation fallback. and add a line about batch_window_ms tradeoffs for long sequences (small windows can hurt p95).
joanne: done — added a sentence and suggested batch_window_ms=25 for mixed workloads.
docs-bot: Link validation: /docs/catalog#supported-models -> 404. likely anchor now /docs/catalog#available-models.
joanne: thanks bot, updated the cross-links and replaced runtime#fallback with runtime#fallback-policies everywhere.
samir: can we sprinkle one bench datapoint for zephyr-mini-4b (p50 A100 vs T4) so readers have expectations? infra gave quick numbers: p50 A100=28 tok/s, p95 T4=7 tok/s. added as indicative note.
mark: also call out Dedicated autoscale cold-start: heavy variants can take ~20-40s; recommend pre-warm for sustained traffic. small blurb under "limits".
joanne: merged after CI green. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/612 (build 7910) :white_check_mark:
mark: LGTM, thanks for the TS snippet.
samir: approving now.
joanne: thanks all 44b will follow up if we need more language variants.
